evidence.excerpt: Hello! We're launching qomplement.com — the first desktop AI agent. It opens apps, clicks buttons, types, and navigates — just like a human would. Just type what you need, and qomplement gets it done across any desktop software. No integrations. No APIs. Just your computer, finally with AI.
